help.title: 🧪 Valheim Notify - Test Mode Help
help.options:
Options:
  --test, -t      Enable test mode (process entire log file)
  --verbose, -v   Show events and log lines in real-time during processing
  --save, -s      Save events (JSON) and log lines to timestamped files
  --help, -h      Show this help message
help.examples:
Examples:
  node vh-notify.js --test                    # Basic test mode
  node vh-notify.js -t -v                     # Test with verbose output
  node vh-notify.js --test --save             # Test and save to files
  node vh-notify.js -t -v -s                  # All options combined
help.info:
In test mode:
- No events are delivered anywhere, no network requests are made
- Entire log file is processed sequentially
- Statistics and event summary are shown
- Progress updates every 100 processed lines
